Summary

PRVREV01 is a batch revalidation sweep program (PEM-4) that scans the Provider Master File to identify active providers whose revalidation due date has passed, in compliance with 42 CFR 455.414 (≤5 years). For each qualifying provider, it writes a rescreen record to the Revalidation Output Queue file and reports the total count of providers queued for revalidation. This program runs as part of the PRVMTH01 month-end batch job (STEP010) and serves as a Main/Driver program with no calling program dependencies.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: VSAM (Indexed), Sequential File - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Capture the current date (today's date) to be used as the reference point for identifying providers whose revalidation due date has passed 2: Provider Master File Sweep - Sequentially read through all provider records in the Provider Master File to evaluate each provider for revalidation eligibility 3: Active Provider Filter - Check each provider record to determine if the provider is currently in Active status; skip inactive providers from revalidation processing 4: Revalidation Due Date Check - Compare the provider's revalidation due date against today's date to identify providers whose revalidation due date has already passed (due date is on or before today), indicating they are overdue for revalidation per 42 CFR 455.414 (5-year revalidation cycle) 5: Queue Provider for Re-screening - For each active provider whose revalidation due date has passed, record the provider's NPI, their revalidation due date, and assign the action 'RESCREEN-REQUIRED' to the revalidation output queue, flagging them for re-screening 6: Revalidation Count Tracking - Maintain a running count of all providers queued for revalidation during the sweep 7: Revalidation Summary Reporting - At the end of processing, display the total number of providers that have been queued for revalidation re-screening during this month-end sweep

Datasource Information (2)

Datasource Name Type Usage
PRV-MASTER-FILE INDEXED (VSAM KSDS) Read sequentially to retrieve all provider records and identify active providers whose revalidation due date has passed
REVAL-OUT-FILE SEQUENTIAL Output file where provider records requiring rescreening are written, including NPI, revalidation due date, and action code 'RESCREEN-REQUIRED'

High level flow diagram

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Program Initialization with Current Date Capture-L_2: ```cobol ACCEPT WS-TODAY FROM DATE YYYYMMDD ``` Provider Master File and Revalidation Output Queue Initialization-L_3: ```cobol OPEN INPUT PRV-MASTER-FILE OPEN OUTPUT REVAL-OUT-FILE ``` Active Provider Status Filter-L_14: ```cobol IF PRV-ACTIVE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD AND PRV-REVAL-DUE-DATE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD <= WS-TODAY PERFORM QUEUE-FOR-REVAL END-IF ``` Revalidation Due Date Eligibility Check-L_14: ```cobol IF PRV-ACTIVE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD AND PRV-REVAL-DUE-DATE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD <= WS-TODAY PERFORM QUEUE-FOR-REVAL END-IF ``` Queue Provider for Re-screening with RESCREEN-REQUIRED Action-L_20: ```cobol MOVE PRV-NPI OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO REV-NPI MOVE PRV-REVAL-DUE-DATE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO REV-DUE-DATE MOVE 'RESCREEN-REQUIRED' TO REV-ACTION WRITE REVAL-OUT-RECORD ``` Revalidation Queue Count Tracking-L_25: ```cobol ADD 1 TO WS-REVAL-COUNT ``` Revalidation Summary Report Display-L_7: ```cobol CLOSE PRV-MASTER-FILE REVAL-OUT-FILE DISPLAY 'PRVREV01: PROVIDERS QUEUED FOR REVAL=' WS-REVAL-COUNT STOP RUN ```

1: Program Initialization

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Capture Today's Date as Revalidation Reference Point-L3: ```cobol ACCEPT WS-TODAY FROM DATE YYYYMMDD ``` Establish Program Identity as PRVREV01 Revalidation Sweep-L2: ```cobol MOVE 'PRVREV01' TO WS-PROGRAM-ID ``` Store Today's Date for Revalidation Due Date Comparisons-L4: ```cobol ACCEPT WS-TODAY FROM DATE YYYYMMDD PERFORM CHECK-NEXT UNTIL WS-END-OF-FILE ```

2: Provider Master File Sweep

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Sequential Sweep of Provider Master File-L1: ```cobol PERFORM CHECK-NEXT UNTIL WS-END-OF-FILE ``` Sequential Sweep of Provider Master File-L2: ```cobol READ PRV-MASTER-FILE NEXT RECORD ``` Detection of Last Provider Record in File-L1: ```cobol MOVE WS-PRV-STATUS TO WS-FILE-STATUS IF WS-FS-EOF SET WS-END-OF-FILE TO TRUE ``` Continuation of Sweep When More Records Exist-L1: ```cobol ELSE IF PRV-ACTIVE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD AND PRV-REVAL-DUE-DATE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD <= WS-TODAY PERFORM QUEUE-FOR-REVAL END-IF END-IF ``` Termination of Provider Master File Sweep-L1: ```cobol MOVE 'N' TO WS-END-OF-FILE-FLAG PERFORM CHECK-NEXT UNTIL WS-END-OF-FILE ``` Termination of Provider Master File Sweep-L2: ```cobol IF WS-FS-EOF SET WS-END-OF-FILE TO TRUE ``` Termination of Provider Master File Sweep-L3: ```cobol CLOSE PRV-MASTER-FILE REVAL-OUT-FILE DISPLAY 'PRVREV01: PROVIDERS QUEUED FOR REVAL=' WS-REVAL-COUNT STOP RUN ```

Business Rules

Capture Provider NPI for Revalidation Queue-L_QUEUE-FOR-REVAL: ```cobol MOVE PRV-NPI OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO REV-NPI ``` Capture Provider Revalidation Due Date for Revalidation Queue-L_QUEUE-FOR-REVAL: ```cobol MOVE PRV-REVAL-DUE-DATE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO REV-DUE-DATE ``` Assign RESCREEN-REQUIRED Action Code to Queued Provider-L_QUEUE-FOR-REVAL: ```cobol MOVE 'RESCREEN-REQUIRED' TO REV-ACTION ``` Write Revalidation Record to Revalidation Output Queue-L_QUEUE-FOR-REVAL: ```cobol WRITE REVAL-OUT-RECORD ADD 1 TO WS-REVAL-COUNT ```
